1 Scientific Literature.Title: Alkali activation of recycled ceramic aggregates from construction and demolition wastes
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: N. Gaibor, J. Coelho, D. Leitão, T. Miranda, P. Tavares, N. Cristelo
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Assess ceramic residue from demolition as alkali-activated binder precursor alone and blended with fly ash or ladle furnace slag, activated with NaOH or sodium silicate.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: CR+FA pastes reached >20 MPa and CR+LFS >59 MPa at 90 d. Best: 75% CR + 25% LFS with sodium silicate, 59.95 MPa at 90 d. Ca-rich CR+LFS mixes formed N,C-A-S-H / C-A-S-H gels; CR+FA formed N-A-S-H.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Ladle slag as co-precursor in alkali-activated binder. Bilingual abstract (English/Spanish).
